lhs: Reduce the row-major reshaped dense operand on the selected axes.
rhs: Reduce the original dense operand on all axes except the paired surviving axes.
conditions: The same surviving shape, including every extent. All surviving axes are paired singleton-to-singleton factors. Static ordered equal-volume common-factor groups, arbitrary rank including scalar and zero extents; source-to-descriptor normalization assumed.
types: Arbitrary scalar type, total pure binary reducer, arbitrary seed; fixed logical row-major left fold.
overlap: Two replacement programs: removing reshape preserves surviving shape; moving reshape preserves surviving volume. Shared projection proof and effort. Distinct from deleting unit reduction axes and reducing a transposed input.

lhs: Reduce the row-major reshaped dense operand on the selected axes.
rhs: Reduce the original operand on the paired reduced axes, then reshape its output to the original surviving shape.
conditions: Equal surviving volumes suffice for the final reshape. All reduced axes are paired singleton-to-singleton factors. Static ordered equal-volume common-factor groups, arbitrary rank including scalar and zero extents; source-to-descriptor normalization assumed.
types: Arbitrary scalar type, total pure binary reducer, arbitrary seed; fixed logical row-major left fold.
overlap: Two replacement programs: removing reshape preserves surviving shape; moving reshape preserves surviving volume. Shared projection proof and effort. Distinct from deleting unit reduction axes and reducing a transposed input.
